mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_wecom_chat_message (gmt_create, gmt_modify, msg_id, send_time_epoch_millis, sender_json, receiver_json, chat_id, msg_type, secret_key) VALUES (NOW(), NOW(), #{msgId}, #{sendTimeEpochMillis}, #{senderJson}, #{receiverJson}, #{chatId}, #{msgType}, #{secretKey}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE gmt_modify = NOW(), send_time_epoch_millis = VALUES(send_time_epoch_millis), sender_json = VALUES(sender_json), receiver_json = VALUES(receiver_json), chat_id = VALUES(chat_id), msg_type = VALUES(msg_type), secret_key = VALUES(secret_key)

INSERT IGNORE INTO b_wecom_chat_message_participant (gmt_create, msg_id, participant_id, participant_type, participant_role) VALUES (NOW(), #{msgId}, #{participantId}, #{participantType}, #{participantRole})
INSERT IGNORE INTO b_wecom_chat_participant (gmt_create, chat_id, participant_id, participant_type) VALUES (NOW(), #{chatId}, #{participantId}, #{participantType})
mapper.select: SELECT sync_key, next_cursor, has_more, total_synced, last_sync_time, last_error FROM b_wecom_chat_sync_state WHERE sync_key = #{syncKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_wecom_chat_sync_state (sync_key, next_cursor, has_more, total_synced, last_sync_time, last_error) VALUES (#{syncKey}, #{nextCursor}, #{hasMore}, #{syncedCount}, NOW(), #{lastError}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_cursor = VALUES(next_cursor), has_more = VALUES(has_more), total_synced = total_synced + VALUES(total_synced), last_sync_time = NOW(), last_error = VALUES(last_error)
